description:
Personal Safety (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.google.android.apps.safetyhub)
Personal Safety is a Pixel app that helps you prepare and react in an emergency by quickly calling emergency services (e.g if your phone detects that you've been in a car crash, it can call for help automatically, but only with a google account)
Most features require a Google account to work except for medical information and emergency contacts. Emergency SOS (ie. pressing the power button 5 times to call emergency services) still works without this app.

This app has obviously a lot of dangerous permissions due to its operation.

Pithus analysis: https://beta.pithus.org/report/e207f7d0f59d9df268154b90fc10cd861d0483465e30bbac8f68a7b12340c67f
